en.name: Our Lady of Lourdes
en.summary: A series of Marian apparitions reported by Bernadette Soubirous in 1858.
en.body: Between February and July 1858, Bernadette Soubirous reported eighteen apparitions of the Virgin Mary at a grotto in Lourdes, France, later approved by the Church.
